architecture_layer: Frontend Shell Foundations — App Router document contract (Phases 0 and 1 of the responsive/mobile refactor)
causal_invariant: The root layout emits a device-width viewport contract, so the App Router document scales to the real device viewport instead of inheriting an implicit desktop canvas.

issue_pr.issue: none — no issue tracker entry exists for this work
issue_pr.pr: none — not opened; no commit requested by the maintainer

operator_flows.flow: Open F.A.M.A. on a mobile browser and read any view without pinch-zoom scaling
operator_flows.expectation: layout width maps to device-width, initial scale 1
operator_flows.negative_control: exporting viewport must not change the server-rendered RootLayout signature or the font CSS variables

operator_flows.flow: Render on a notched device in landscape
operator_flows.expectation: content is allowed to extend under the notch; no horizontal scrollbar is introduced
operator_flows.negative_control: text-size-adjust stays at 100% so iOS landscape does not inflate typography

odd_assessment: Honest scope note: this phase introduces no new telemetry, state machine, or monitoring surface. ODD yields no additional artifact here because the only new externally observable surface is the <meta name="viewport"> and <meta name="theme-color"> pair asserted in the test suite. The next ODD-bearing phase is the shell drawer state, which will need a breakpoint/visibility contract recorded.
deferred_out_of_scope: Fase 2: DashboardView responsive grids, chart clipping, truncate and flex-wrap defects
Fase 3: TrainingView log console word-break, table min-width, flex-shrink-0 toggle, td display:flex hazard
Fase 5 (deferred by maintainer decision): collapsible sidebar via components/shell/AppShell.tsx plus app/page.tsx h-dvh and main overflow-x containment

Known mobile defect NOT fixed here: iOS Safari focus-zoom inflates the page because form controls render below 16px. The global fix would raise control font size on mobile and can shift layout inside PredictionView and IngestionView, which are owned by the RF_06 task, so it is deferred to a phase where the affected components can be edited and visually verified.

Known mobile defect NOT fixed here: Sidebar.tsx fixes w-56 (224px) with no breakpoint, leaving roughly 151px of usable width on a 375px device. This is the single largest mobile blocker and is fully gated behind Fase 5.
